description: SPECS golden-output cases. Each case runs `specs <args>` in a fresh temporary working directory prepared by `setup` (circuits/ copied from the repo so that `.include circuits/...` resolves, and an empty traces/ dir because testbenches and the default trace file write to traces/<name>.vcd relative to the cwd). Optional keys: expect (documentation only: fail|crash), note, timeout (s), vcd_ignore_values (regexes on hierarchical VCD signal names that are not compared at all, only their declaration), ignore_files (globs), ignore_streams / unordered_streams ([stdout|stderr]: not compared / compared as a multiset of lines; every other stream must keep its line order), rlimit_nofile (soft open-files limit of the specs process).
